name: Decomposition Tree v3
description: Expandable left-to-right decomposition tree with synthetic Total root, drill-by-dimension picker, optional two-measure comparison with variance bars, Top-N + Others rollup, story-level selection events, theme presets, density modes, conditional formatting, and full theming control.

feeds.description: Measure (bind 1 for standard mode; bind 2 to enable comparison mode — second measure becomes plan/target)

setExpandedLevel.description: Expands nodes up to the requested zero-based level.

setData.description: Sets data from script for local testing or advanced use.

selectNode.description: Programmatically select a node by its ID. Fires onNodeSelected.

clearSelection.description: Clear the current selection. Fires onNodeDeselected if there was one.

getSelection.description: Returns the current selection payload (nodeId, label, value, filters[], etc.) or null.

expandPath.description: Drill into the tree by member labels, e.g. expandPath(['EMEA','Germany']). Returns { ok, depth, nodeId }.

getState.description: Returns a serializable snapshot of expansion, level-dimension choices, and selection for bookmark persistence.

setState.description: Restores the widget to a previously saved state from getState(). Re-materializes expanded subtrees.

exportPng.description: Exports the visible tree as a PNG image download. Options: { filename, scale, background }.

exportCsv.description: Exports the visible tree as a CSV file download. Options: { filename, separator, includeHidden }.

onNodeClick.description: Triggered when a node is clicked (legacy, retained for backward compatibility). Same payload as onNodeSelected.

onNodeExpand.description: Triggered when a node is expanded.

onNodeCollapse.description: Triggered when a node is collapsed.

onNodeSelected.description: Triggered when a node becomes the active selection. event.detail = { nodeId, label, value, level, pctOfParent, pctOfTotal, filters: [{dimension, dimensionName, member}], measure }.

onNodeDeselected.description: Triggered when the active selection is cleared by user action. event.detail = { nodeId } of the previously selected node.
